answers.text: Make sure that you are logged in to the same Xiaomi Account on your laptop and tablet
Make sure you have added your laptop to Xiaomi Home. Reference method:
If you have PC Manager version 5.8.x installed
a. Open Remote Control on your laptop and log in to your Xiaomi Account

figures.caption: Fig. 1: Log in to your Xiaomi Account in Remote Control

answers.text: b. Change the laptop to a status that allows pairing

figures.caption: Fig. 1: In the Remote Control app on your laptop, click "Settings > Xiaomi Network Module Manager > Add to Xiaomi Home" and change the laptop to a status that allows pairing

answers.text: c. Pair with your laptop using the Xiaomi Home app on your phone

figures.caption: Fig. 1: Xiaomi Home automatically shows a pop-up when it discovers a nearby device
Fig. 2: Tap "+" in the upper right corner of the Xiaomi Home app to add a device
Fig. 3: Scan for nearby devices
Fig. 4: Or, manually add the device by selecting "Work and study - Laptop"
Fig. 1: Click the laptop icon to start the pairing process

answers.text: If you have PC Manager version 6.x installed
a. In PC Manager, go to Tools > Xiaomi Network Module, and click "Add device"

figures.caption: In PC Manager, go to Tools > Xiaomi Network Module, and click "Add device"

answers.text: Check that the laptop's Xiaomi Network Module is connected to the Internet
a. If you have PC Manager version 5.8.x installed

figures.caption: Fig. 1: Go to Remote Control > Settings > Xiaomi Network Module Manager
Fig. 2: Select "Module network" to manually add the network

answers.text: b. If you have PC Manager version 6.x installed

figures.caption: In PC Manager, go to Tools > Xiaomi Network Module, and check the module status

items.question: Why can't I make my laptop power on, power off, or sleep?

answers.text: Similar to the issue above, make sure that your tablet and laptop are logged in to the same Xiaomi Account, the laptop has been added to Xiaomi Home, and the Xiaomi Network Module is connected to the Internet.

items.question: Why can't I see my laptop on my phone or tablet?

answers.text: Check the settings below and try again:
Make sure that the laptop is powered on and connected to the Internet. You can [[power on your laptop remotely|remote_control_en.html]]
Make sure that your phone, tablet and laptop are all logged in to the same [[Xiaomi Account|#step1]]
Check that Xiaomi PC Manager on your laptop has been updated to version 5.8 or later, then [[open File Services|#step1]]
